description: Creates, rotates or revokes the app's login key, for apps with their own user accounts: their server posts it with { externalId, email?, name? } to POST https://neblla.com/api/apps/<appId>/auth/token for a one-minute token, and the page calls neblla.auth.login({ token }). Shown once; whoever has it can sign in as any user, so it stays in the server's environment. create (refused if one exists) and rotate wait in the app's queue until neblla_promote "save", the old key working until then; revoke cuts at once. create/rotate: owner only. More: neblla_get_llms tools/auth_secret

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name: neblla_auth_secret
title: Manage the login key
